description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LicenseService within the OrangeHRM admin module. It contains unit tests to verify functionality related to license data management, including retrieving license lists, deleting licenses, and fetching licenses by ID or name.

classes.name: LicenseServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LicenseService component in OrangeHRM, focusing on license retrieval, deletion, and lookup functionalities.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of License objects using LicenseService.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Tests the deletion of licenses via LicenseService.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single License object by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a License object by its name.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test method execution.
